_note: The coach's MOOD topics (session M1, GDD 4.9.4; user 2026-10-17: 'a line + a topic when low'): when motivation is Low or Flat, confidence Low, or stress Stressed or worse, the Sunday talk's first topic is one of these (topic 'mood', condition `mood`; StoryletSystem._post_week_talk puts it first). Normal storylets otherwise (format in README.md). The mood effects are points (x data/mind.json news.moment_point, and from the coach x his Motivating and the trust factor). Voice-neutral wording. Real content (not test).

text: {name}, you've seemed a bit flat lately. What's going on?
Your sessions have looked heavy, {name}, and not only in the legs. Tell me honestly: how are you?

replies.label: I'm bored of the same training
replies.result: Fair. Then let's change something: a new session in the week, or the week itself in the Training tab. Variety keeps the head fresh.

replies.label: I'm just tired
replies.result: Then we take a little off this week. Tired and flat often go together.

replies.label: I'm fine
replies.result: All right. My door is open if that changes.

text: {name}, the last races have knocked you. How are you feeling about racing?
You don't look like you believe in yourself right now, {name}. Talk to me.

replies.label: I'm starting to doubt myself
replies.result: Doubt is normal. Your training hasn't gone anywhere. We look at what went right, and we go again.

replies.label: I'm angry. I want to prove it
replies.result: Good. Use it in training, keep it calm on race day.

replies.label: I'm OK, really
replies.result: Then show me on the track.

text: You seem wound up lately, {name}. Is there a lot going on?
{name}, you look stressed. Is it the training, or something else?

replies.label: Yes, a lot going on
replies.result: Then training should be the easy part this week. We take a little off.

replies.label: I can manage
replies.result: Good. Breathe, sleep, and tell me if it gets too much.

replies.label: I don't want to talk about it
replies.result: That's fine. I'm here if you do.
